aiResearchSummary.text: Barefoot Networks is researching and developing methods for configuring hardware switches, such as configuring a switch for extracting packet header fields and packet header field extraction, as well as using stateful traffic management data to perform packet processing. Their work includes algorithmic TCAM based ternary lookup, data plane program verification, and augmenting data plane functionality with field programmable integrated circuits. These areas focus on programmable, high-performance network infrastructure.
